input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data using either an input samplesheet or an input directory and where to save data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

fastq_pass.description: Path to directory containing either barcoded fastq files or individually named fastq files
fastq_pass.help_text: Barcodes must be formatted as 'barcode##' to be found. Fastq files must end in '.fastq' or '.fastq.gz'

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

virus_name.description: Virus name that sets virus specific processes and nextclade runs
virus_name.$comment:
Currently, this virus name option is set to run nextclade with the predefined dataset according to the named virus.
 Additionally, it currently runs the COVID virus specific subworkflow. Future use will possibly include more predefined options.

required_settings.title: Required Settings
required_settings.description: Settings that are required to run the pipeline

variant_caller.description: Choose which variant caller to use. Options are 'clair3', 'medaka', and 'nanopolish'

reference.description: Path to reference genome fasta file

amplicon_settings.title: Amplicon Settings
amplicon_settings.description: Settings required for running amplicon data

primer_bed.description: Path to 6 column (minimum) tab separated amplicon primer bed file with first column matching reference ID

clair3_settings.title: Clair3 Settings
clair3_settings.description: Settings pertaining to the clair3 variant calling workflow.

clair3_model.description: Model to use in clair3. See clair3 docs for more info. Be as accurate as possible for best results!

clair3_local_model.description: Path to local clair3 model folder

clair3_no_pool_split.description: Pass to not split amplicon pools when running clair3

min_qual_clair3.description: Minimum clair3 variant quality to PASS variant to final consensus

min_frameshift_qual.description: Minimum clair3 frameshift (indel divisible by 3) variant quality to PASS variant to final consensus

min_allele_freq.description: Minimum clair3 allele frequency to PASS variant to final consensus

min_mask_freq.description: Minimum clair3 allele frequency to mask a variant with an N in the final consensus

clairS-TO_settings.title: ClairS-TO Settings
clairS-TO_settings.description: Settings pertaining to the ClairS-TO minor variant calling workflow.

clairsto_model.description: Model to use in ClairS-TO. See ClairS-TO docs for more info. Be as accurate as possible for best results!

min_snv_af_clairS.description: Minimum clairS-TO allele frequency to PASS minor single nucleotide variants

min_indel_af_clairS.description: Minimum clairS-TO allele frequency to PASS minor insertions and deletions

min_cov_clairS.description: Minimum clairS-TO coverage to PASS minor variants

min_qual_clairS.description: Minimum clairS-TO quality to PASS minor variants

medaka_settings.title: Medaka Settings (If using over clair3)
medaka_settings.description: Settings pertaining to the medaka variant calling workflow if using medaka over clair3

medaka_model.description: Model to use in medaka. See medaka docs for more info. Be as accurate as possible for best results!

skip_longshot.description: If passed, skip running longshot with medaka pipeline

nanopolish_settings.title: Nanopolish Settings (If using over clair3)
nanopolish_settings.description: Settings pertaining to the nanopolish variant calling workflow if using nanopolish over clair3. *NOTE*: nanopolish only works on R9 flowcells

fast5_pass.description: Path to directory containing fast5 files REQUIRED for nanopolish

sequencing_summary.description: Path to sequencing_summary file REQUIRED for nanopolish

read_filtering_options.title: Read Filtering Options
read_filtering_options.description: Options pertaining to which samples to drop and how to filter reads

min_reads.description: Minimum reads required to run the sample after length filtering

general_analysis_options.title: General Analysis Calling Options
general_analysis_options.description: Options pertaining to all variant calling methods

normalise.description: Normalize coverage for each amplicon to this threshold

min_depth.description: Minimum depth to call a position. Positions lower are masked with an N

minor_variants.description: Enable minor variant calling with ClairS-TO

no_frameshift.description: Filter out INDEL variants that are not divisible by 3 (likely frameshift but not necessarily)

metadata.description: Path to metadata TSV file containing at least columns 'sample' and 'barcode'

use_artic_tool.description: Pass to run tool artic pipeline instead of the nextflow adaptation this pipeline uses

skip_qc.description: If passed, skip running all QC and reporting steps

pcr_primer_bed.description: Path to 6 column (minimum) tab separated PCR primer bed file with first column matching reference ID to report mutations in these locations

neg_control_threshold.description: Float threshold for a negative control sample to be considered contaminated

neg_ctrl_substrings.description: Control prefixes separated by a ',' to determine which samples are negative controls

snpeff_options.title: SnpEff options
snpeff_options.description: Options pertaining to running SnpEff for variant annotation

nextclade_options.title: Virus name Nextclade options
nextclade_options.description: Options pertaining to pulling & running nextclade

nextclade_dataset_name.description: Name of the nextclade dataset to use.

nextclade_dataset_tag.description: Tag for the nextclade dataset to use.

virus_specific_options.title: Virus specific options
virus_specific_options.description: Options pertaining to running virus specific workflow options

skip_pangolin.description: If passed, skips running pangolin for Covid

report_generation_options.title: Report generation options
report_generation_options.description: Options pertaining to final report generation

multiqc_report.description: Create MultiQC report instead of custom report

multiqc_config_overall.description: MultiQC overall run config yaml file

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
